description: Add 'cto' to CRO agent's subagents.allowAgents list
reason: Chris (CEO) directly requested this so CTO can spawn sub-agents in CRO sessions for cross-functional technical support (e.g., CRM integration, lead import tooling).
risk_assessment: LOW — Adding 'cto' to the allowAgents list only permits the CRO to spawn the CTO as a sub-agent. It does not modify models, channels, bindings, or any existing functionality. The CTO agent is already configured and running.
